# Free SFX Download

> Free SFX Download is a free library of 521 CC0 (public domain) sound effects for video editors, short-form creators, podcasters and game developers. Every sound can be downloaded in one click as MP3 (320 kbps) or WAV (48 kHz, 24-bit), with no sign-up, and may be used commercially without attribution.

Key facts:
- Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal for every file, including our edited versions (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
- Sources: BigSoundBank (Joseph Sardin), Kenney.nl and CC0 authors on OpenGameArt. Per-file credits are on each sound page and the License page.
- Editing: silence trimmed, short fades, loudness about -14 LUFS, true peak at or below -1 dBTP.
- Each category can be downloaded as a ZIP (MP3 + WAV + licence file).
- Curated by The FreeSFX Download team; no copied film/TV/meme clips and no AI-generated sounds.

## Categories
- [Cartoon & Funny sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/cartoon-funny/): 71 sounds. Rimshots, record scratches, horns, laughs, bonks and boings for comedy edits.
- [Laughs & Applause sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/laughs-applause/): 21 sounds. Applause, cheering, baby and toddler giggles, evil laughs and crowd walla.
- [Human & Voice Reactions sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/human-reactions/): 28 sounds. Screams, sighs, yawns, coughs, sneezes, burps, shushes, snaps and crunches.
- [Whooshes & Transitions sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/whooshes-transitions/): 31 sounds. Swooshes, swipes and fly-bys for cuts, text and zoom transitions.
- [Impacts & Hits sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/impacts-hits/): 31 sounds. Punches, slams, gongs, clangs and knocks for emphasis.
- [Booms & Explosions sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/booms-explosions/): 20 sounds. Explosions, thunder claps, sub booms and bangs.
- [Risers & Sweeps sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/risers-sweeps/): 17 sounds. Rising tension, sweeps and power-ups that lead into a drop or reveal.
- [Pops sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/pops/): 18 sounds. Cork pops, balloon pops, bubble wrap and quick UI pops.
- [Glitches & Sci-Fi sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/glitches-sci-fi/): 19 sounds. Data glitches, static bursts, lasers and UFO fly-bys.
- [Notifications & Alerts sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/notifications-alerts/): 27 sounds. Pings, dings, bells, chimes, success and error tones.
- [UI & Clicks sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/ui-clicks/): 20 sounds. Mouse clicks, trackpad, buttons, toggles and switches.
- [Camera Shutters sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/camera-shutters/): 16 sounds. DSLR, film camera, flash camera and burst-mode shutter clicks.
- [Money & Coins sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/money-coins/): 16 sounds. Coin drops, coin spins, cash register beeps and casino chips.
- [Typing & Paper sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/typing-paper/): 17 sounds. Typewriter keys and bell, page turns and paper crumple.
- [Horror & Suspense sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/horror-suspense/): 21 sounds. Ghosts, zombies, heartbeats, creaking doors, ear ringing and ticking clocks.
- [Retro Game & 8-Bit sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/retro-game-8bit/): 28 sounds. 8-bit jumps, power-ups, coins, lasers and game voice lines like "Game over".
- [Animals sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/animals/): 26 sounds. Dogs, cats, farm animals, birds, owls, frogs, bees and flies.
- [Sports & Games sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/sports-games/): 15 sounds. Referee whistles, boxing bell, ball kicks and bounces, dice and pinball.
- [Doors & Household sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/doors-household/): 21 sounds. Knocks, door slams, doorbells, drawers, cupboards, glasses and switches.
- [Vehicles, Horns & Sirens sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/vehicles-horns/): 22 sounds. Car, truck, bus, train and ship horns, sirens, tyre screeches and engines.
- [Nature & Weather sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/nature-weather/): 20 sounds. Thunder, rain, wind, waves, streams, fire, birds and night crickets.
- [Guns & Weapons sound effects](https://mydevspace2.github.io/free-sfx-download/guns-weapons/): 16 sounds. Rifle and shotgun shots, reloads, shell casings, swords, knives and arrows.
